examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 小張對世界地理和歷史相當有興趣，為了打開視野，他決定花一年的時間出國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng duì shìjiè dìlǐ hé lìshǐ xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, wèile dǎkāi shìyě, tā juédìng huā yì nián de shíjiān chūguó lǚxíng.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is quite interested in world geography and history. In order to broaden his vision, he decided to spend a year traveling abroad.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 隔壁家的小子相當懂事，附近的鄰居們都很喜歡他。
examples.pinyin: Gébì jiā de xiǎozi xiāngdāng dǒngshì, fùjìn de línjūmen dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: The young fellow next door is quite sensible; the neighbors nearby all like him very much.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
examples.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

examples.chinese: 青少年期的心理變化相當大，需要父母及老師多關心。
examples.pinyin: Qīngshàonián qī de xīnlǐ biànhuà xiāngdāng dà, xūyào fùmǔ jí lǎoshī duō guānxīn.
examples.english: During the adolescent period, psychological changes are quite large, and parents and teachers need to care more.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng Lǐ jiàoshòu lái yǎnjiǎng, nèiróng xiāngdāng jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yǒu hěn dà de shōuhuò.
examples.english: The school invited Professor Li to give a lecture; the content was quite wonderful, which gave me a great harvest.

examples.chinese: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yuètuán zhǔchàng de chànggē jìqiǎo, duì yuètuán yǎnchū biǎoxiàn de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: The lead vocalist's singing skills have a considerable impact on the band's performance.

examples.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
examples.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

examples.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
examples.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

examples.chinese: 在指導演員的表達方式上，這位導演的經驗相當豐富。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhǐdǎo yǎnyuán de biǎodá fāngshì shàng, zhè wèi dǎoyǎn de jīngyàn xiāngdāng fēngfù.
examples.english: In guiding actors' ways of expression, this director's experience is quite rich.

examples.chinese: 一小部分人引起的戰爭使人民付出了相當大的代價。
examples.pinyin: Yī xiǎo bùfèn rén yǐnqǐ de zhànzhēng shǐ rénmín fùchū le xiāngdāng dà de dàijià.
examples.english: The war caused by a small group of people made the people pay a considerable price.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 他相當迷那位明星，因此不管穿的用的都模仿他。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiāngdāng mí nà wèi míngxīng, yīncǐ bùguǎn chuān de yòng de dōu mófǎng tā.
examples.english: He is quite obsessed with that star, so regardless of what he wears or uses, he imitates him.

examples.chinese: 想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng xiǎobiàn de shíhou qiānwàn bié rěnnài, fǒuzé duì jiànkāng de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: When you need to urinate, never hold it in, otherwise the impact on your health is considerable.

examples.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
examples.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
examples.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

examples.chinese: A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
examples.pinyin: A: Nà suǒ dàxué suīrán xiāngdāng zhùmíng, dàn wǒguó zhèngfǔ bù chéngrèn tāmen de xuéwèi. B: Xǔduō guójiā dōu chéngrèn nà suǒ dàxué de xuéwèi, guìguó nǎlǐ yǒu bù chéngrèn de dàolǐ?
examples.english: A: Although that university is quite famous, our government does not recognize their academic degrees. B: Many countries recognize that university's degrees—how could your esteemed country have any reason not to recognize them?

examples.chinese: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù dǎbàn de xiāngdāng jiǎngjiū, ràng wǒ duì tāmen cóngshì de hángyè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This couple dresses quite elegantly, which makes me very interested in the profession they are engaged in.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
examples.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎodài zài zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn xiāngdāng yōuxiù, tóu zhòng le sānshí duō fēn, yīncǐ bèi jiàoliàn xuǎn zhòng, dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài.
examples.english: Xiaodai performed quite excellently in this basketball game, hitting over thirty points, and was therefore selected by the coach to represent the school in the national competition.

examples.chinese: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú shèjì tú huà de hěn zǐxì, huà tú de rén yīnggāi xiāngdāng xìxīn.
examples.english: This design drawing is drawn very carefully; the person who drew it must be quite meticulous.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

examples.chinese: 李博士在國際上相當有名，他的研究總能引發學者討論。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóshì zài guójì shàng xiāngdāng yǒumíng, tā de yánjiū zǒng néng yǐnfā xuézhě tǎolùn.
examples.english: Dr. Li is quite famous internationally; his research always sparks discussions among scholars.

examples.chinese: 這面金牌是完全用金子做的，外觀也相當獨特。
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn jīnpái shì wánquán yòng jīnzi zuò de, wàiguān yě xiāngdāng dútè.
examples.english: This gold medal is made entirely of gold, and its appearance is also quite unique.

examples.chinese: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái shípǐn jiāgōng shèbèi de gòuzào xiāngdāng fùzá, qízhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de língjiàn hái shì yóu guówài jìnkǒu.
examples.english: The structure of this food processing equipment is quite complex, and about one third of its parts are still imported from abroad.

examples.chinese: 我的家鄉出產小麥、葡萄，可是不產茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiāxiāng chūchǎn xiǎomài, pútao, kěshì bù chǎn chá.
examples.english: My hometown produces wheat and grapes, but it does not produce tea.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 要是你想知道山區天氣的情況，上網看看氣象預報就行了。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng zhīdào shānqū tiānqì de qíngkuàng, shàngwǎng kànkan qìxiàng yùbào jiù xíng le.
examples.english: If you want to know the weather conditions in the mountains, just go online and check the weather forecast.

examples.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
examples.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

examples.chinese: 我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guó sìjì dōu yǒu měilì de fēngjǐng: chūnjì shí píngyuán yǒu huāhǎi, xiàjì shí hǎitān yǒu rìchū, qiūjì shí shānqū yǒu hóngshù, dōngjì shí gāoshān yǒu báixuě, dōu shífēn mírén.
examples.english: Our country has beautiful scenery in all four seasons: in spring, the plains have seas of flowers; in summer, the beaches have sunrises; in autumn, the mountains have red trees; in winter, the high mountains have white snow—all are very charming.

examples.chinese: 為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, táifēng tiān dào shānqū lùyíng de xíngwéi shì bèi yángé jìnzhǐ de.
examples.english: For the sake of safety, camping in mountainous areas on typhoon days is strictly prohibited.

examples.chinese:
陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。
小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin:
Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà.
Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english:
Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great.
Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán yāoqiú yuángōng děi chuān xīzhuāng shàngbān, dàn fèiyòng quán shì gōngsī fùdān de.
examples.english: Although this company requires employees to wear suits to work, the cost is entirely borne by the company.

examples.chinese: 身體不舒服時，就應該吃對身體負擔較小、容易消化的食物。
examples.pinyin: Shēntǐ bù shūfu shí, jiù yīnggāi chī duì shēntǐ fùdān jiào xiǎo, róngyì xiāohuà de shíwù.
examples.english: When you feel unwell, you should eat food that is less of a burden on the body and easy to digest.

examples.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒ shǎo chī yóu, yán hé táng, yǐ jiǎnqīng shēntǐ de fùdān.
examples.english: The doctor reminded me to eat less oil, salt, and sugar in order to lighten the body's burden.

examples.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
examples.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 在機構、組織擔任的職位越高，代表個人所負擔的責任越重。
examples.pinyin: Zài jīgòu, zǔzhī dānrèn de zhíwèi yuè gāo, dàibiǎo gèrén suǒ fùdān de zérèn yuè zhòng.
examples.english: The higher the position one holds in an institution or organization, the heavier the responsibility the individual bears.

examples.chinese: 黃小姐為家人買了定期健康保險，萬一有需要時就可以減輕負擔。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě wèi jiārén mǎi le dìngqī jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn, wànyī yǒu xūyào shí jiù kěyǐ jiǎnqīng fùdān.
examples.english: Miss Huang bought regular health insurance for her family, so that if there is a need, it can reduce the burden.

examples.chinese:
中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。
小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu.
Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together.
Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán yāoqiú yuángōng děi chuān xīzhuāng shàngbān, dàn fèiyòng quán shì gōngsī fùdān de.
examples.english: Although this company requires employees to wear suits to work, the cost is entirely borne by the company.

examples.chinese: 爸爸挑選西裝時，最重視的是品質，其次才是式樣。
examples.pinyin: Bàba tiāoxuǎn xīzhuāng shí, zuì zhòngshì de shì pǐnzhì, qícì cái shì shìyàng.
examples.english: When Dad chooses a suit, what he values most is quality; style comes second.

examples.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
examples.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
examples.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

examples.chinese: 他第一次嘗試滑雪，跌了好幾次，好不容易才學會。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì huáxuě, diē le hǎo jǐ cì, hǎobùróngyì cái xuéhuì.
examples.english: He tried skiing for the first time, fell several times, and only managed to learn it with great difficulty.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩跑得太快，一不小心就跌倒了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái pǎo de tài kuài, yībùxiǎoxīn jiù diēdǎo le.
examples.english: That child ran too fast and accidentally fell down.

examples.chinese: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
examples.pinyin: Dài háizi dào cāntīng yòngcān, děi tíxǐng tāmen bié dàochù bēnpǎo, miǎnde diēdǎo.
examples.english: When taking children to a restaurant to eat, you must remind them not to run around, so they don't fall.

examples.chinese: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Zhāng lǎobǎn píngrì chī de, yòng de dōu hěn shěng, qíshí tā shì mǒu jiā dàxíng diànzǐ qǐyè de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: Don't be fooled by how economical Boss Zhang is in what he eats and uses every day—he's actually the boss of a large electronics company.

examples.chinese: 人們為了節省勞力，發明了許多實用的機械。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen wèile jiéshěng láolì, fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng de jīxiè.
examples.english: In order to save labor, people invented many practical machines.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友會理頭髮，為了省錢我們常常去找他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu huì lǐ tóufa, wèile shěng qián wǒmen chángcháng qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: My friend can cut hair; in order to save money, we often go to him.

examples.chinese: 我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng lǚxíngshè dài dìng cóng Táiběi zhífēi Měiguó de bānjī, jīpiào jiào guì, dàn néng jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: I asked the travel agency to book a flight from Taipei directly to the US; the ticket is more expensive, but it can save quite a bit of time.

examples.chinese: 冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì de wēndù yàoshi kòngzhì de gānghǎo, bùdàn duì jiànkāng hǎo, yě néng shěng diǎnr diànfèi.
examples.english: If the air conditioner's temperature is controlled to be just right, it is not only good for health but also saves a bit on electricity bills.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jùlí gōngsī hěn jìn, shěng le hěn duō shíjiān yǔ jiāotōngfèi.
examples.english: The place where I live is very close to the company, which saves a lot of time and transportation costs.

examples.chinese: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
examples.pinyin: Wánquán ànzhào biérén de huà lái gōngzuò, shì hěn shěngshì méicuò, què shīqù le ràng zìjǐ jìnbù de jīhuì.
examples.english: Working completely according to others' words is indeed very trouble-saving, but it loses the opportunity to let yourself improve.

examples.chinese: 我每個月都會清一次冷氣，這樣比較省電，風也比較涼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi gè yuè dōu huì qīng yī cì lěngqì, zhèyàng bǐjiào shěng diàn, fēng yě bǐjiào liáng.
examples.english: I clean the air conditioner once every month; this way it saves more electricity, and the air is cooler too.

examples.chinese: 不管做任何事都應先了解情況，省得白花精神。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zuò rènhé shì dōu yīng xiān liǎojiě qíngkuàng, shěngde bái huā jīngshén.
examples.english: No matter what you do, you should first understand the situation, so as to avoid wasting energy in vain.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese: 他很愛惜東西，所以東西都能用很久，省了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn àixī dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi dōu néng yòng hěn jiǔ, shěng le bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: He really cherishes things, so things can all be used for a long time, and he has saved quite a bit of money.

examples.chinese: 在台北市租房子太貴了，住在郊區可以省一點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiběi shì zū fángzi tài guì le, zhù zài jiāoqū kěyǐ shěng yīdiǎnr qián.
examples.english: Renting a house in Taipei City is too expensive; living in the suburbs can save a little money.

examples.chinese: 在人生地不熟的地方旅行時，如有當地人帶路，就可以節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Zài rénshēngdìbùshú de dìfāng lǚxíng shí, rú yǒu dāngdìrén dàilù, jiù kěyǐ jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: When traveling in a place where you are unfamiliar with the people and surroundings, if a local leads the way, you can save quite a bit of time.

items.wordHook: One of 少(few) 目(division)s in a country is a 省(province).

examples.chinese: 我不太會跳高，跳遠倒是跳得還不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì tiàogāo, tiàoyuǎn dàoshì tiào de hái bùcuò.
examples.english: I am not very good at high jump, but as for long jump, I am actually not bad.

items.wordHook: a 工(craft) smooths a 丂(obstruction of breath) into a fine curve → 巧(skillful).
Combining 英(petal) and 俊(talented): 英俊 means handsome.
計(calculate) + 程(distance) + 車(vehicle) → a vehicle that calculates the distance you ride, so a taxi.
